description: Report the status of an export started by create_catalog_export. download_url points at the finished export. A job is derived from its id rather than stored, so it never expires and needs no polling: the status is succeeded the moment create_catalog_export returns.

job_id.description: The job id returned by create_catalog_export.

name: get_export_job

download_url.description: Where to fetch the finished export.

error.description: Why it failed, when it did.

status.description: Always "succeeded". Nothing is queued, so nothing can fail later.

title_count.description: How many titles the export holds.

title: Check a Vooks catalog export
